title: Creamy Pea and Petit Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful soup made with petit pois and a touch of saltiness from velvety cheese.
instructions: Melt the salty butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the petit pois and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Stir in the velvety cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional petit pois if desired.
